title: Lock file without a plugin API version
description: composer.lock declares a composer.lock that records no plugin API version. Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a composer.lock that records no plugin API version.
remediation: Regenerate the artifact with integrity data enabled and commit the recorded digest or checksum. Specifically: fix a composer.lock that records no plugin API version.
limitation: It matches a composer.lock that records no plugin API version in the parsed composer.lock; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
